what: This line defines a command-line argument named `using` that allows users to configure the Rack server settings.
why: The original code was created because Genadi Samokovarov accidentally typed `rails server production` instead of the correct `--e production` flag. He wanted a way to consistently launch the Rails server in production mode without needing to remember the exact command syntax [1][2]. The goal was to provide a clear and explicit option for configuring the Rack server [3].
next: Before making any changes, verify that removing this argument would break the ability to launch the Rails server in production mode, and that users would be left without a clear way to specify server configurations.
